stdout: --selector:filter a list by Kubernetes label `selector`, e.g. app=web,tier!=cache (kubectl's -l)
--wait:wait for the resource to reach its default wait condition, or --for, before returning
--for:wait for `condition`, e.g. state=active or condition=Ready (starts the wait)
--debug:print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
--no-input:never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
--project:list only objects in the project's namespaces; an object you name must be in one of them
--read-only:refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
